items.t: Tesla Takes 1.2M SF at Houston’s Cedar Port Industrial Park
items.sum: Tesla signed a 1.2 million-square-foot-plus lease at Cedar Port Industrial Park near Baytown, though its plans for the space remain unclear.

items.t: SpaceX, Tesla have had a bumpy 2026 thus far: What to know
items.sum: Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi focuses on Elon Musk's two public companies — SpaceX (SPCX) and Tesla (TSLA) — and their respective stock performances in 2026. While getting a slight boost at the time of this video's posting, SpaceX is still trading below its IPO price of $135 per share.
